content:
The simulation successfully implemented conditional capacity planning with precise backlog propagation and step-down logic for work-day transitions.
The model correctly initialized Week 4 using the formula 'Calc Start = 438.81 - Demand' to satisfy the starting constraint. It maintained state by using the signed 'End of Week Backlog/Buffer' as the next week's 'Calc Start' while reporting only positive values as 'Past Due'. Transition weeks for 6-to-5 and 5-to-4 day shifts were accurately identified based on backlog thresholds.
